suite.name: Krater Evidence-Native Foundation Tasks
suite.description: Twenty deterministic infrastructure acceptance tasks derived from the broader Krater catalog. These small tasks validate fixture and sealed-checker plumbing; they are not substitutes for the expert benchmark.

tasks.title: Strict Port Parser
tasks.prompt: Repair parsePort so it accepts only canonical decimal ports from 1 through 65535 and rejects partial, padded, signed, empty, or out-of-range input.
acceptanceCriteria: Canonical decimal port strings produce the corresponding integer.
Malformed and out-of-range values fail explicitly instead of being partially parsed.

tasks.title: Stable Unique Sequence
tasks.prompt: Repair stableUnique so duplicate values are removed while the order of first appearance and JavaScript SameValueZero identity semantics are preserved.
acceptanceCriteria: The first occurrence order is preserved without sorting.
Repeated NaN and signed zero values follow Set-style identity semantics.

tasks.title: Immutable Interval Merge
tasks.prompt: Repair mergeIntervals to validate intervals, merge every overlap correctly, produce sorted output, and leave all caller-owned arrays unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: Nested and chained overlaps are merged into canonical sorted intervals.
Invalid intervals fail and neither the input list nor its child arrays are mutated.

tasks.title: Dependency-Aware Job Order
tasks.prompt: Repair orderJobs to return a deterministic dependency-respecting order and reject missing dependencies, duplicate identifiers, and dependency cycles.
acceptanceCriteria: Every declared dependency appears before the job that consumes it.
Cycles and references to missing jobs fail explicitly.

tasks.title: Bounded Retry Delay
tasks.prompt: Repair retryDelay so nonnegative retry attempts use capped exponential backoff without overflow and malformed numeric configuration fails explicitly.
acceptanceCriteria: Delay growth is exponential and never exceeds the configured maximum.
Negative attempts and invalid limits are rejected while large attempts remain finite.

tasks.title: Confined Child Path
tasks.prompt: Repair isSafeChildPath so it uses path-component semantics, accepts genuine descendants, and rejects the root itself, traversal, and lexical prefix collisions.
acceptanceCriteria: A normalized descendant below the root is accepted.
Sibling prefixes, traversal results, and the root path itself are rejected.

tasks.title: Structured Secret Redaction
tasks.prompt: Repair redactSecrets to remove bearer credentials and API-key assignment values while preserving unrelated prose and field names for useful diagnostics.
acceptanceCriteria: Supported credential values do not survive in the returned string.
Unrelated words and non-secret diagnostic content remain intact.

tasks.title: Chained Event Digest
tasks.prompt: Repair hashEvent so each digest commits to the previous digest and a deterministic key-ordered event encoding, returning lowercase SHA-256 hexadecimal.
acceptanceCriteria: Changing the previous digest changes the resulting event digest.
Equivalent event objects have a deterministic lowercase SHA-256 representation.

tasks.title: True LRU Cache
tasks.prompt: Repair LruCache so reads and updates refresh recency, eviction removes the least recently used entry, and invalid capacity is rejected.
acceptanceCriteria: A successful get protects that key from the next capacity eviction.
Updating a key preserves size and nonpositive capacity is rejected.

tasks.title: Truthful Action Gate
tasks.prompt: Repair classifyAction so established satisfaction abstains, known partial repairs are distinguished, reproduced defects require change, and insufficient facts cannot establish action.
acceptanceCriteria: Already-satisfied work is classified separately from change-required work.
Partial fixes and insufficient evidence receive their own conservative classifications.

tasks.title: Strict Boolean Decoder
tasks.prompt: Repair parse_bool so common explicit true and false spellings decode case-insensitively after trimming, while ambiguous values raise ValueError.
acceptanceCriteria: Explicit true and false strings decode to actual booleans.
Ambiguous or unsupported strings are rejected rather than treated as truthy.

tasks.title: Bounded Sequence Chunks
tasks.prompt: Repair chunks so it yields only nonempty order-preserving chunks, handles empty input without output, and rejects a nonpositive chunk size.
acceptanceCriteria: Exact multiples do not produce a trailing empty chunk.
Empty input is empty and nonpositive chunk sizes fail explicitly.

tasks.title: Non-Mutating Deep Merge
tasks.prompt: Repair deep_merge so nested dictionaries merge recursively into fresh structures, unrelated keys survive, and caller-owned values are not mutated.
acceptanceCriteria: Nested mappings merge recursively while right-side scalar values win.
Neither caller-owned input mapping is changed as a side effect.

tasks.title: Quoted CSV Record
tasks.prompt: Repair parse_csv_line to parse one RFC-4180-style record, including quoted commas, doubled quotes, and trailing empty fields without lossy splitting.
acceptanceCriteria: Quoted separators and doubled quotes decode into the intended field values.
A trailing delimiter produces a final empty field.

tasks.title: Boundary-Correct TTL Cache
tasks.prompt: Repair TtlCache so entries expire at the exact deadline, invalid TTL values are rejected, and time remains injectable for deterministic behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: An entry is unavailable when the clock equals or exceeds its deadline.
Nonpositive TTL values fail before mutating the cache.

tasks.title: Unicode Slug Normalizer
tasks.prompt: Repair slugify to normalize accented Latin text, lowercase it, collapse punctuation and separators, and remove leading or trailing separators.
acceptanceCriteria: Accented Latin characters normalize into their ASCII base forms.
Runs of punctuation collapse to one hyphen without edge hyphens.

tasks.title: Atomic Text Edit Set
tasks.prompt: Repair apply_edits so all coordinates refer to the original text, nonoverlapping edits apply atomically, and malformed or overlapping ranges fail.
acceptanceCriteria: Multiple nonoverlapping edits use original-text coordinates regardless of length changes.
Overlapping and invalid ranges are rejected before any partial result is returned.

tasks.title: Conservative Taint Join
tasks.prompt: Repair join_labels so combining context labels always returns the most restrictive known sensitivity, treats no labels as public, and rejects unknown labels.
acceptanceCriteria: The most restrictive label dominates every less restrictive input label.
An empty set is public and unknown labels fail closed.

tasks.title: Tamper-Evident Resume Cursor
tasks.prompt: Repair encodeCursor and decodeCursor so cursor payloads round-trip deterministically and an HMAC bound to the supplied secret rejects modification or the wrong key.
acceptanceCriteria: Untampered cursor state round-trips without changing its JSON value.
Any token modification or verification under a different secret fails closed.

tasks.title: Conservative Evidence Grade
tasks.prompt: Repair gradeClaim so failed evidence prevents establishment and successful observations, tests, and stress tests produce only their justified conservative grade.
acceptanceCriteria: Any contradictory or failed required evidence yields not-established.
Ordinary tests never produce a formally-verified claim grade.
